events.text:
I fixed the dry-run bug on a new branch, `fix-dry-run`, and committed it as `cde80ec`. All 4 tests pass.

- **Cause:** `tidy_folder` accepted the `dry_run` flag but never checked it, so it renamed files on every run.
- **Fix:** in `tidy.py`, it now renames only when `dry_run` is false. The `old -> new` lines are printed either way.
- **Test:** I added `test_tidy_folder_dry_run_renames_nothing` in `test_tidy.py`. It checks that a dry run reports the change it would make and that the folder still holds only the original file name afterwards.

I haven't pushed the branch or opened a PR.

> Post to scrap? **Day summary, Sat 21 Nov 2026: tidy dry-run fix, weekend jobs, k3s backups** · note · #home #scrap #tech #project/-root-demo-tidy · links: 7 related · ~45 lines

```markdown
A Saturday of small fixes: tidy's --dry-run bug was fixed and its README gained a Usage section (both on local branches), two tpi-k3s-ansible backup PRs were merged, mcwb PR #1 was reviewed, and Claude sessions in scrap took stock of the weekend's house jobs and camping packing.

## Timeline
- **tidy: --dry-run renamed files anyway** (this session). Fixed in `tidy_folder` (it ignored `dry_run`), added a test, 4/4 tests pass. Commit `cde80ec` on local branch `fix-dry-run`.
- **Weekend house jobs** (this session). All 5 jobs on [[house-jobs-this-weekend-2122-nov-2026]] are still open; a status check was appended to it.
- **Day summary** (this session). Asked the other sessions, read GitHub and scrap, and wrote this page.

## Sessions
- **tidy-readme** [3ce028]: added a Usage section to tidy's README (dry run first, then a real run) plus a Tests heading. Commit `e81adaa` on local branch `readme-usage`, not pushed (no remote). The README says --dry-run changes nothing, which is only true once `fix-dry-run` is merged.
- **camping** [ec7ad5]: wrote [[camping-trip-still-to-pack-and-buy-gas-on-saturday]] (stove and gas, head torches and first aid kit still to pack; buy gas canisters on Saturday morning), linked to [[camping-kit-for-the-weekend]]. "Which Saturday" was left as an open question.

## Findings
- **tidy**: `tidy_folder(folder, dry_run)` took the flag but always renamed. It now renames only when `dry_run` is false.
- **House**: plumber (high) and gutters (medium) were due today, the fence is due Mon 24 Nov, and car insurance has been overdue since 19 Nov.

## Decisions
- The tidy fix and the README change are on separate branches. Merge `fix-dry-run` before or together with `readme-usage` so the README isn't wrong in between.
- The status check was appended to the existing weekend-jobs page, which Claude wrote, instead of making a new one.

## Changes made
### tidy (local, /root/demo/tidy; no remote)
- `fix-dry-run`: `cde80ec` Make --dry-run print changes without renaming (`tidy.py`, `test_tidy.py`). Not merged.
- `readme-usage`: `e81adaa` README: add Usage section showing dry run first. Not merged.

### gilesknap/tpi-k3s-ansible
- Merged #775 Retry failed off-site uploads, and log diagnostics on listing errors (08:56).
- Merged #776 Split the backup canmount line on whitespace, not a literal backslash-t (15:52).
- Merged #774 Update Helm release kube-prometheus-stack to v93.6.1 (04:59, Renovate; no event of yours).

### gilesknap/mcwb
- Reviewed PR #1 Refresh to copier template 5.4.0, Python 3.11-3.14 and Minecraft 26.3 items: about 20 review comments around 15:04. Still open.

### DiamondLightSource/dls-tiled
- Reviewed PR #36 Add Trivy container image scan. Still open.

### gilesknap/scrap
- Opened #593 MCP write: say what `created` means on an append.
- Commented on #549 Demo video.

### scrap
- 16:22: a bulk load of about 55 pages (todos, notes, reads, contacts, receipts) under your account on the web. Topic pages created at the same moment: [[running-the-house]], [[the-garden-through-the-year]] and 6 others.
- Claude over MCP: created [[house-jobs-this-weekend-2122-nov-2026]] and appended to it (rev 2); created [[camping-trip-still-to-pack-and-buy-gas-on-saturday]].
- No tag/kind changes and nothing trashed or restored today. 8 topic pages refreshed today.

## Open questions
- [ ] Merge `fix-dry-run`, then `readme-usage`, in tidy (and add a remote if it should be pushed).
- [ ] Call the plumber, clear the gutters, and renew the car insurance (overdue).
- [ ] Turn the tulips/rosemary note into a todo?
- [ ] mcwb #1 and dls-tiled #36: follow up on the reviews.
```

- **Contacts:** the scrap section counts the contact pages but doesn't name anyone, since names would put other people's personal details on the page.

- **Incomplete GitHub check:** when I ran all the GitHub checks in one command, it was blocked. I re-ran each check on its own and that worked, except the mcwb issues check, which failed because issues are turned off on that repo.

Shall I post it?
